name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set a barbell securely across your upper traps, step back with feet shoulder-width apart, and turn your toes slightly out.
Take a deep breath into your belly, brace your core tightly, and keep your chest tall.
Bend your hips and knees together and descend as far as you can with your feet planted and your trunk steady.
Drive evenly through your midfoot and heels to stand tall with the bar balanced over your center of foot.
tips: Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes rather than collapsing inward.
Keep your heels flat on the floor and maintain a neutral spine from top to bottom.
